lesson: A status line rendered as a top-level return from Answer() is NOT inside .ask-answer, and the ONLY rule for .ask-period-status is the descendant selector '.ask-answer .ask-period-status' (globals.css:1518) — so the reopen pending line at ask-panel.tsx:151 renders 16px near-black body text instead of 11px slate (proven live via getComputedStyle). Give it className="ask-answer ask-period-status", exactly as the ask-failure branch three lines above already does.
